programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El mecánico Cory corre contra el reloj para convertir dos bombas de agua de corto alcance en aviones transatlánticos para el viaje épico a Turquía. Depende del ingeniero Adam sacar a la tripulación del C-46 de un atasco en una pista de aterrizaje remota en menos 40. Y cuando el capitán Devan y el copiloto Scott encuentran la amenaza de la cizalladura del viento en el famoso Bear Rock.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un vuelo charter cae por las grietas después de que los McBryans asisten a una boda familiar salvaje, y un furioso Joe saca al capitán Justin de los vuelos de prueba de Turquía para hacer el trabajo. La tarea de Justin es trasladar a un británico impaciente, su perro y todas sus posesiones mundanas a un remoto puesto avanzado del norte, pero el clima no está cooperando.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un furioso Joe lucha contra una suspensión federal que le impedirá transportar pasajeros por primera vez en 20 años. También es un revés para Jeremy y las otras rampas, que empeora con una lesión inesperada. Para el equipo de waterbomber de Turquía, finalmente es una oportunidad.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: AJ y Candace se casan en el Castillo de Hielo. Un frustrado Chuck intenta que la Electra le pague. Mikey, desconcertado, intenta hornear un pastel para el cumpleaños de Joe. Y en Terranova, una fuga de combustible, un curso de supervivencia aleccionador y un trágico choque sacudieron a la tripulación de Turquía. Cuando los fuertes vientos brinden la ventana meteorológica tan esperada.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La tripulación de Turquía hace el salto crítico sobre el Atlántico Norte. Pero en el camino a Portugal, un equipo se ve obligado a regresar. Sin potencia en un motor y sin forma de mantener la altitud, deben regresar a Santa María, donde el aeropuerto está en alerta de emergencia completa. Y Mikey y Scott buscan una nueva rampie, mientras que las esperanzas de Jeremy se desploman aún más.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Las tripulaciones C-46 y DC-4 compiten contra el deshielo primaveral para volar equipos mineros a una pista de aterrizaje en un lago congelado. Jeremy intenta alcanzar a sus compañeros rampies Audrey y Wilf. Y en el último tramo a Turquía, Arnie y Justin se enfrentan a algunos volcanes serios y al intenso tráfico aéreo del Mediterráneo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de miles de horas de preparación minuciosa y vuelo peligroso, un terrible accidente devasta a la tripulación de los bombarderos de agua en Turquía, y a todos en Buffalo. La primera carrera de Wilf como azafata levanta las cejas entre el personal. Y un aficionado a los aviones escoceses cumple el sueño de su vida cuando Joe lo deja viajar en el asiento del capitán de su DC-3.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando su esposo renuncia después de un reventón con Joe, Kelly se pone en una posición terrible. ¿Se quedará en Buffalo o se irá? Scott recibe la noticia de que debe retirarse del vuelo para que otro copiloto pueda acelerar el paso al capitán. Él hace todo lo posible para asegurar una nueva carta, pero su rival también quiere volar el nuevo trabajo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de la amarga partida de su esposo de Buffalo, Kelly tiene una confrontación que decide si ella también renunciará. Jeremy comete un error que podría terminar con su carrera en Buffalo. La escasez de gasolina de aviación trae una dosis de realidad aleccionadora a los McBryans. Y después de una visita de su madre, el destino le lanza a Scott una inesperada bola curva.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren una Fuente de la Juventud cuidada por un espantoso Troll que roba el libro mágico de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Habia Una Vez Una Luna Azul
programme.desc: Una noche de Luna Azulada, tal y como la leyenda decía, un bebé pitufo aparece en el pueblo, y todos acaban cogiéndole cariño. Pero todo ha sido un malentendido y la cigüeña vuelve a por el bebé. Pintor y Gruñón se han encariñado tanto con el bebé que la acaban devolviéndoles el bebé.

programme.title: Lenguaje De Señas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos conocen a un elfo del bosque, que les enseña la lengua de signos después de que Gargamel les administre una poción de enmudecimiento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Una Brujita No Tan Mala
programme.desc: Mientras hacen un recado para Papá Pitufo en el conservatorio de las brujas, las pequeñas criaturas azules conocen a una diminuta bruja y le enseñan cómo ser buena; al mismo tiempo, hacen que otra bruja pierda sus poderes maléficos durante un año al caer en el río.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Busqueda De La Piedra Magica
programme.desc: En el lejano Valle de Nodrog, los Pitufos se encuentran con El Molians, que quiere conseguir la Pitufo-Piedra que Papá Pitufo necesita para curar.

programme.title: Las Nuevas Colinas Pitufas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren que no hay ningún sitio como el hogar cuando Gargamel consigue que su libro de hechizos conjure un nuevo lugar más hermoso para que los Pitufos vivan en él: ¡un lugar perfecto para que pueda tenderles una trampa!

programme.title: Campanas De Boda Para Gargamel
programme.desc: Los Pitufos se hacen amigos de una dama en apuros que está prometida a Gargamel, ya que convencen a su padre de que el estúpido mago está loco.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos ayudan a una reina de las hadas a vencer al malvado Falan, que intenta robar el sonajero mágico de su hijo.

programme.title: A Todas Las Criaturas Grandes Y Pequeñas
programme.desc: Pitufo Natural está convencido de que puede ayudar a todas las criaturas con sus dones curativos, incluso al malvado Azrael, cuya pata queda atrapada en una trampa. El gato se cura y, a pesar de que tiene la tentación de quedarse con los Pitufos, regresa con Gargamel, pero conduce a su dueño hacia un lugar alejado de la Aldea Pitufa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Pitufo Que Queria Ser Rey
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador anhela convertirse en rey después de leer una historia sobre reyes. Mientras está en su barco, cae a través de un remolino y llega a una tierra de pequeños seres que creen que Pitufo Soñador es su rey, desaparecido hace mucho tiempo. Cuando se enfrenta a los Norfnangs, los enemigos de esos pequeños seres, descubre que no son terroríficos en absoluto. Pitufo Soñador se da un golpe en la cabeza y descubre al despertar que todo había sido un sueño, aunque encuentra en su gorro una joya idéntica a las que extraían esos pequeños seres de su mina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel quiere crear un monstruo. Una criatura horrible y gigantesca, ¡un ser imponente que destruya a todos los Pitufos! Pero Gargamel comete un pequeño error y el resultado les dejará asombrados a su gato Azrael y a él.

programme.title: El Castillo De Las Disputas
programme.desc: En el Castillo de las Disputas casi nunca se escuchan palabras amables. El brujo Selwyn y su pareja, la bruja Tallulah, se pasan el tiempo discutiendo. Tharp, la gárgola que tienen como mascota, se refugia en la Aldea Pitufa. Pero algo terrible va a suceder…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A veces ocurren accidentes. ¡En esta ocasión, un error de Pitufo Bromista hace que su sombra cobre vida! Y a la sombra le encanta hacer bromas a todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El último invento de Pitufo Carpintero, la cámara de fotos pitufomática, parece el tipo de objeto capaz de reemplazar el pausado arte de Pitufo Pintor. Sin embargo, las fotos aéreas de la Aldea Pitufa tomadas por Pitufo Carpintero caen en manos de Gargamel. La única esperanza de los Pitufos es lograr confundirlo.

programme.title: Así Es La Vida
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos gritan a Pitufo Carpintero cuando sus inventos se estropean, por lo que decide abandonar la aldea. Pero, cuando Gargamel usa las máquinas abandonadas por Pitufo Carpintero para atrapar Pitufos, Pitufo Carpintero se da cuenta de que no puede abandonar a sus amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo se convierte por accidente en rey de los Trokels. Cuando Pitufo Filósofo comienza a dar órdenes en lugar de hacer lo que los Trokels quieren, deciden destronarle… lo que para ellos significa arrojarle por un precipicio. Pitufo Filósofo aprende que ser un líder significa mucho más que dar órdenes.

programme.title: El Cachorro De Papi
programme.desc: Un golpe en la cabeza hace que Puppy pierda la memoria. Gargamel lo encuentra y decide entrenarlo para cazar Pitufos. Juntos, logran atrapar a los Pitufitos. Pero Gargamel da otro golpe a Puppy en la cabeza y este recuerda quiénes son sus verdaderos amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Navidad De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren el espíritu deportivo, la alegría y la amista cuando llevan a cabo sus primeros "Juegos Pitufos". Los Pitufos deciden ponerse en forma tras casi perder contra el gato Azrael.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel está decidido a sobrevolar la Aldea Pitufa para atrapar a un Pitufo y llevarlo a la Convención de los Magos, e invoca a su libro de hechizos para que le ayude. Esto da lugar a una serie de divertidos contratiempos con su máquina voladora, y Gargamel vuelve a convertirse en el hazme reír de la Convención de los Magos.

programme.title: El Primer Telepitufo
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo vierte una poción mágica sobre el nuevo sembrado de melones, que crecen instantáneamente e inundan la aldea y el bosque. Los Pitufos usan las flores a modo de teléfono; sin embargo, antes de que Gargamel pueda rastrear sus voces, las flores se convierten en melones y eso significa el fin del telepitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En su búsqueda de algo novedoso, Pitufo Vanidoso se pone un sombrero mágico creado por Gargamel que le deja la cara hecha un adefesio. Mediante una argucia, Papá Pitufo consigue robarle el antídoto al malvado mago, logrando así que Pitufo Vanidoso recupere su belleza.

programme.title: Poema Al Tiempo
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero, Pitufo Filósofo, Pitufo Torpe y Pitufina descubren el reloj de arena del tiempo en una cueva y empiezan a trastear con él, lo que provoca que el tiempo se descontrole para todos los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Mejor Memoria De La Aldea
programme.desc: A consecuencia de un loco experimento, Pitufo Torpe puede ahora almacenar interminables conocimientos en su memoria. Gargamel lo captura e intenta que le revele la fórmula de invisibilidad de Papá Pitufo, pero, en el último segundo, Pitufo Torpe le engaña diciéndole unos ingredientes erróneos.

programme.title: El Buen Vecino De Pitufo
programme.desc: Cuando la casa de Pitufo Filósofo se quema, se muda con sus compañeros Pitufos; y, uno detrás de otro, le echan debido a sus intromisiones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo le da a Pitufo Debilucho una crema especial para que la utilice y recupere su fuerza. Poco después, recibe una condecoración por sus heroicos actos de fortaleza, y su autoestima se dispara cuando se da cuenta de que la crema es simplemente mermelada de pitufrutas.

programme.title: Armonía La Estrella De La Función
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía firma inconscientemente un contrato con Escritor Fantasma para escribir una sinfonía, lo que hace que quede atrapado en un club nocturno fantasmal para siempre. Papá Pitufo exige un juicio con un jurado y un juez de fantasmas, que declaran inocente a Pitufo Armonía y culpable de plagio a Escritor Fantasma.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La bruja Hogata promete a Gargamel un silbato mágico si este le presenta al brujo de sus sueños. Sin embargo, ambos se engañan mutuamente con sus triquiñuelas: Gargamel se disfraza de brujo, y el silbato mágico de Hogata es simplemente un reclamo para aves.

programme.title: Una Campana Para Azrael
programme.desc: Gargamel lanza un hechizo a una campana atada a la cola de Azrael que conducirá al gato hasta los Pitufos. Pero Papá Pitufo es más astuto que él y lanza un contra hechizo que lleva al mago hasta Gigantón, en lugar de hasta los deliciosos Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Fortachón se disfraza de Pitufina para atraer a Piltkin, el gnomo que se ha enamorado de ella, y alejarlo de la Aldea Pitufa. Excavan bajo tierra y conocen a una gnoma que se enamora de Piltkin, quien se olvida de Pitufina y pasa a tener ojos solo para su nueva conquista.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogata consigue los pendientes dorados mágicos de Sonoria, que le permitirán oír las voces de los Pitufos desde lejos. Siguiendo los ronquidos de Pitufo Perezoso, está a punto de llegar hasta la Aldea Pitufa, pero entonces los sonidos del cuerno de Pitufo Armonía comienzan a resonar en sus pendientes y huye enfurecida de vuelta a casa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las pinturas del malvado Maestro son capaces de tele portar a sus modelos dentro del cuadro…para siempre! Papá pitufo le dice a Pintor que cambie las pinturas y en poco tiempo Maestro acaba dentro de uno de sus cuadros, al lado de su modelo de ensueño: Pitufina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogatha se disfraza de premio de oro para observar a los Pitufos y capturarlos para sus ingredientes de belleza. Vanidoso acaba convenciéndola de que pruebe su receta y acaba cubierta de barro de vuelta a casa de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo organiza un grupo para navegar a una lejana isla ya que Gargamel ha cortado todos los árboles menos uno para atrapar a los pitufos. Gargamel les sigue pero la Bruja de la isla acaba enviando sus gaviotas tras él.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aprenden que la mente es más fuerte que la materia gracias a un engañoso y caro tónico milagroso de un charlatán. Pero Papá Pitufo les hará ver que no es más que un charlatán.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Durante una misión para interrumpir la fiesta de Halloween de los Pitufos, Gargamel y Hogatha consiguen capturar a Perezoso, el cual se ha vuelto rojo por un extraño capricho de la naturaleza. Papá Pitufo y los demás conseguirán liberar a Perezoso, y la Madre Naturaleza devolverá su color al pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado primo del Rey, Malcolm, lo ha convertido en un ciervo negro para poder acabar con él y ponerle en su sala de trofeos. Los Pitufos irán a ayudar a su amigo y, tras devolver al Rey a su verdadera forma, Malcom acabará preso dentro del cuerpo del ciervo negro.

programme.title: Pitufos Y Solo Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido capturar a Pitufina. Ahora, se dispone a administrarle un suero de la verdad para descubrir todos los secretos de Papá Pitufo… pero Gargamel comete un gran error y le da a Pitufina una fórmula de las mentiras.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Secreto Del Pantano De Las Sombras
programme.desc: Pitufo Gruñón, que odia todo, detesta especialmente su propia fiesta de cumpleaños, por lo que decide esconderse en el Pantano de las Sombras. Allí encontrará extraños seres y vivirá aventuras aún más extrañas mientras los demás Pitufos le buscan…

programme.title: Pituplicación
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel crea una fórmula mágica que duplica todo aquello que toca. Y…¡sorpresa! ¡Ahora hay seis Pitufos Filósofos! Esto provoca algunas situaciones interesantes en la aldea… ¡Y también en casa de Gargamel!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un dragón aterroriza la Aldea Pitufa. Para vencer al dragón, los Pitufos deben encontrar al famoso viajero chino. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo es capaz de entender las peculiares costumbres del extranjero, e incluso de hablar algunas palabras en su idioma.

programme.title: El Hombre De La Luna
programme.desc: Cansado y harto de que no le aprecien, el Hombre de la Luna deja su trabajo y se retira en la Tierra, en la Aldea Pitufa. La ausencia de la luna en cuarto creciente desata el caos en las costumbres de los Pitufos, y Madre Naturaleza y Padre Tiempo también se ven arrastrados por el embrollo…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hay un premio para aquel Pitufo que tenga la mascota más adorable. Bebé Pitufo acude con Cariño Dorado, una mascota adorable y cariñosa de la que todo el mundo se enamora. Sin embargo, esa mascota es una creación del malvado mago Gargamel con la que pretende destruir a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Símbolos De Sabiduría
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo está desesperado por parecerse más a Papá Pitufo. ¿Podría ser la respuesta un tónico capilar? ¿Conseguirá Gargamel capturar por fin a los Pitufos? ¿Reside realmente la sabiduría en una barba?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo se siente preparado para la ocasión cuando empieza a preparar una receta de galletas. Está convencido de que va a ganar el concurso, ya que ha tomado prestada una receta del libro de magia de Papá Pitufo. Sin embargo, una gran sorpresa y algunas situaciones desagradables aguardan al pobre Pitufo Filósofo y a toda la aldea.

programme.title: Secreto Del Pozo De La Aldea
programme.desc: ¿Por qué Pitufo Torpe espera día y noche junto al pozo de la aldea? ¿Cuál es el deseo que quiere mantener en secreto? ¿Y cómo está involucrado Gargamel en este asunto misterioso? ¿Logrará Gargamel atrapar por fin a los Pitufos?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos deben encontrar a una familia de conejos para tirar de su carroza durante el Festival de Otoño. Gargamel ve la oportunidad de capturar a los pequeños seres azules y se disfraza de conejo gigante. ¿Conseguirá atrapar a todos los Pitufos de un plumazo?

programme.title: Detente A Pitufar Rosas
programme.desc: La malvada hechicera Clorhidris quiere borrar todo el amor y la belleza de la faz de la tierra. Para ello, debe aniquilar la arboleda de los elfos de los bosques, donde la encantadora elfa muda Laconia cuida de las flores silvestres. Sin embargo, los Pitufos están ahí para salvar la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Celoso por la atención que recibe Pitufo Vanidoso cuando se rompe un dedo del pie, Pitufo Bromista finge estar enfermo con la esperanza de que le hagan caso. Desafortunadamente, su treta se vuelve en su contra y, en lugar de amorosos cuidados, todo lo que recibe es un proverbial merecido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado Acechador, que captura animales silvestres para venderlos, tiene a Abuelo Pitufo y a Pitufo Salvaje de los nervios. Nana Pitufa y Smoogle acuden al rescate, capturando al Acechador en una de sus propias trampas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Tras malinterpretar algo que oye, Pitufo Reportero publica que Gargamel desea ser amigo de los Pitufos. Gargamel convence a Pitufo Reportero para que le lleve hasta la Aldea Pitufa para hacer el anuncio en persona. Gargamel secuestra a los Pitufos, y Pitufo Reportero es ahora el responsable de escribir la historia de su rescate.

programme.title: Niñeras Chapuseras
programme.desc: Mientras Pitufo Carpintero, Pitufo Filósofo y Pitufo Goloso discuten, Hogata secuestra a Bebé Pitufo para preparar una fórmula para tener la piel suave como la de un bebé. Ellos tres, acompañados de Smoogle, tendrán que dejar a un lado sus rencillas para rescatar a Bebé Pitufo de las garras de Hogata.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel despide a Escrupuloso, que se va a vivir con Gigantón. Mientras los Pitufitos ayudan a Gigantón a organizar una fiesta, Escrupuloso los captura para congraciarse con Gargamel. Pero no cuenta con que Gigantón acudirá al rescate.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel ha echado tantas sustancias tóxicas en su estanque que el agua se vuelve encantada. Tras caerse en el estanque, Gargamel se vuelve pequeño, tan pequeño que Papá Pitufo tendrá que salvarlo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Por pura casualidad, un elefante que pasaba por el bosque se encuentra con Bebé Pitufo, y los Pitufos deciden crear un gran Circo. Van a visitar al hechicero infernal Baltazar y Bebé Pitufo se lo está pasando genial…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Epidemia De La Tos Saltarina
programme.desc: Gargamel propaga un extraño germen por el bosque que hace toser a todos sin parar. Bebé Pitufo es la primera víctima y todo el pueblo está muy preocupado…Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo cree conocer la solución.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado hechicero Gargamel acude una vez más a Esmeralda, la adivinadora, la cual se las ingenia para hacerse con el dinero de Gargamel. Cuando es el turno de los Pitufos, les hace creer que existe un árbol de la suerte…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Caballo Anaranjado De Los Zapatos De Oro
programme.desc: Deslizándose por un arcoíris, un caballito alado pierde una herradura dorada. Tras encontrarse con Pitufina, ambos van en su búsqueda. Al final, acaban encariñándose ya que quién podría resistirse al encanto de un caballito alado…o de Pitufina?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hay algún tipo de poder maligno en la corona del Titan que Minero encuentra bajo tierra, y Avaricioso acaba sucumbiendo a él. Cuando Gargamel aparece con una de sus fechorías en mente, todo se acaba enrevesándose.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel está decidido a sobrevolar la Aldea Pitufa para atrapar a un Pitufo y llevarlo a la Convención de los Magos, e invoca a su libro de hechizos para que le ayude. Esto da lugar a una serie de divertidos contratiempos con su máquina voladora, y Gargamel vuelve a convertirse en el hazme reír de la Convención de los Magos.

programme.title: El Primer Telepitufo
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo vierte una poción mágica sobre el nuevo sembrado de melones, que crecen instantáneamente e inundan la aldea y el bosque. Los Pitufos usan las flores a modo de teléfono; sin embargo, antes de que Gargamel pueda rastrear sus voces, las flores se convierten en melones y eso significa el fin del telepitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En su búsqueda de algo novedoso, Pitufo Vanidoso se pone un sombrero mágico creado por Gargamel que le deja la cara hecha un adefesio. Mediante una argucia, Papá Pitufo consigue robarle el antídoto al malvado mago, logrando así que Pitufo Vanidoso recupere su belleza.

programme.title: Poema Al Tiempo
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero, Pitufo Filósofo, Pitufo Torpe y Pitufina descubren el reloj de arena del tiempo en una cueva y empiezan a trastear con él, lo que provoca que el tiempo se descontrole para todos los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Mejor Memoria De La Aldea
programme.desc: A consecuencia de un loco experimento, Pitufo Torpe puede ahora almacenar interminables conocimientos en su memoria. Gargamel lo captura e intenta que le revele la fórmula de invisibilidad de Papá Pitufo, pero, en el último segundo, Pitufo Torpe le engaña diciéndole unos ingredientes erróneos.

programme.title: El Buen Vecino De Pitufo
programme.desc: Cuando la casa de Pitufo Filósofo se quema, se muda con sus compañeros Pitufos; y, uno detrás de otro, le echan debido a sus intromisiones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo le da a Pitufo Debilucho una crema especial para que la utilice y recupere su fuerza. Poco después, recibe una condecoración por sus heroicos actos de fortaleza, y su autoestima se dispara cuando se da cuenta de que la crema es simplemente mermelada de pitufrutas.

programme.title: Armonía La Estrella De La Función
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía firma inconscientemente un contrato con Escritor Fantasma para escribir una sinfonía, lo que hace que quede atrapado en un club nocturno fantasmal para siempre. Papá Pitufo exige un juicio con un jurado y un juez de fantasmas, que declaran inocente a Pitufo Armonía y culpable de plagio a Escritor Fantasma.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La bruja Hogata promete a Gargamel un silbato mágico si este le presenta al brujo de sus sueños. Sin embargo, ambos se engañan mutuamente con sus triquiñuelas: Gargamel se disfraza de brujo, y el silbato mágico de Hogata es simplemente un reclamo para aves.

programme.title: Una Campana Para Azrael
programme.desc: Gargamel lanza un hechizo a una campana atada a la cola de Azrael que conducirá al gato hasta los Pitufos. Pero Papá Pitufo es más astuto que él y lanza un contra hechizo que lleva al mago hasta Gigantón, en lugar de hasta los deliciosos Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Fortachón se disfraza de Pitufina para atraer a Piltkin, el gnomo que se ha enamorado de ella, y alejarlo de la Aldea Pitufa. Excavan bajo tierra y conocen a una gnoma que se enamora de Piltkin, quien se olvida de Pitufina y pasa a tener ojos solo para su nueva conquista.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogata consigue los pendientes dorados mágicos de Sonoria, que le permitirán oír las voces de los Pitufos desde lejos. Siguiendo los ronquidos de Pitufo Perezoso, está a punto de llegar hasta la Aldea Pitufa, pero entonces los sonidos del cuerno de Pitufo Armonía comienzan a resonar en sus pendientes y huye enfurecida de vuelta a casa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las pinturas del malvado Maestro son capaces de tele portar a sus modelos dentro del cuadro…para siempre! Papá pitufo le dice a Pintor que cambie las pinturas y en poco tiempo Maestro acaba dentro de uno de sus cuadros, al lado de su modelo de ensueño: Pitufina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogatha se disfraza de premio de oro para observar a los Pitufos y capturarlos para sus ingredientes de belleza. Vanidoso acaba convenciéndola de que pruebe su receta y acaba cubierta de barro de vuelta a casa de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo organiza un grupo para navegar a una lejana isla ya que Gargamel ha cortado todos los árboles menos uno para atrapar a los pitufos. Gargamel les sigue pero la Bruja de la isla acaba enviando sus gaviotas tras él.

programme.title: Charade

programme.title: That Touch of Mink

programme.title: Commando (1985)
programme.desc: An ex-commando is pressed back into service when his daughter is kidnapped.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programme.desc: A Navy navigator is shot down over enemy territory and is pursued by a secret police enforcer.

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: Camp Crystal Lake has been shuttered for over 20 years due to several vicious and unsolved murders. The camp's new owner and seven young counselors are preparing the property for reopening despite warnings from residents about a "death curse."

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part II
programme.desc: Five years after the bloodbath at Camp Crystal, all that remains is the legend of Jason and his demented mother, who had murdered seven camp counselors. At a nearby summer camp, the new counselors are unconcerned about the warnings to stay away.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: The Big Boss
programme.desc: Bruce Lee faces an underground criminal element after members of his family begin disappearing. Now he must break his vow of non-violence to take on the terrifying "Big Boss."

programme.title: Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Bruce Lee stars as Chen Zhen, a martial arts protégé who returns to his former school in Shanghai when he learns that his beloved instructor has been murdered. To avenge his master's death, Chen must fight the greatest assassins from a rival school.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Snatched
programme.desc: A nice guy goes into the hospital for surgery and through a series of mishaps suffers every man's worst nightmare.

programme.title: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
programme.desc: Frozen in the '60s, secret agent Austin Powers is thawed back into action to once again battle his archenemy, Dr. Evil. With his sexy sidekick, Ms. Kensington, Austin must stop Dr. Evil's outrageous plot to control the world.

programme.title: Austin Powers: The Spy Who Shagged Me
programme.desc: The International Man of Mystery must travel back to the Swinging Sixties, track down his stolen mojo, and thwart Dr. Evil's plot to destroy the world.

programme.title: Kate & Leopold
programme.desc: When a rip in time brings together a charming 19th-century bachelor and a thoroughly 21st-century woman, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites!

programme.title: Little Women
programme.desc: Based on the classic 1868 novel about love, family, and the female spirit, Louisa May Alcott tells the domestic saga of the March family.

programme.title: The Taking of Pelham 123
programme.desc: Four ruthless hijackers take over a New York City subway train and hold the passengers for ransom. They threaten to shoot one each minute until the ransom is fully paid.

programme.title: A Time to Kill
programme.desc: Old ways die hard. It's the lesson learned by Carl Lee Hailey, a Mississippi factory worker, when two racist thugs brutally assault his ten-year-old daughter on a drunken spree.

programme.title: Rachel Getting Married
programme.desc: When Kym returns to the Buchman family home for her sister Rachel's wedding, she brings a long history of personal crises, family conflict, and tragedy. Rated -R

programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: The early years of larger-than-life American figure Howard Hughes are captured by legendary director Martin Scorsese in this acclaimed Oscar-winning biopic starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Cate Blanchett.

programme.title: Wild Horses
programme.desc: A detective opens up a fifteen-year-old missing persons case and begins to suspect that the boy it belongs to was murdered - and that a local rancher was involved.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: The Goonies
programme.desc: With brothers Mikey and Brand's house slated for demolition by greedy developers, the boys' only hope lies in finding a long-lost treasure. They uncover a treasure map and, with their friends, descend to a subterranean sea and an abandoned galleon.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Three-time male model of the year, Derek Zoolander, is devastated when he loses the title to newbie Hansel. After the news, Mugatu's fashion empire brainwashes Derek into being an assassin.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: Tripp is a 35-year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him? It’s free, he’s got a great room, and Mom does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
programme.desc: When Army Major Susan Turner (Cobie Smulders) is framed for treason, Reacher discovers she's the target of a massive government conspiracy.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: Steve Martin turns in a heartwarming and hilarious performance.

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: Isaac Hayes is a bounty hunter who is after a strong-armed pimp who has skipped bail. In the hunt, the pimp is killed but his girlfriend takes a contract out on Hayes.

programme.title: Breakheart Pass
programme.desc: As a train races through the Rocky Mountains, the passengers are being murdered! The only hope is John Deakin (Charles Bronson) who uncovers a secret that explodes in a torrent of shocking revelations, explosive brawls, and blazing gun battles.

programme.title: The Matrix
programme.desc: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence. Every second becomes a fight to stay alive - to escape The Matrix.

programme.title: The Matrix Reloaded
programme.desc: In the second chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Zion falls under siege by the Machine Army. Neo and Trinity choose to return to the Matrix with Morpheus. Now, Neo must follow the path he has chosen if he is to save humanity.

programme.title: Mona Lisa Smile
programme.desc: Julia Roberts stars as a novice art history professor with a surprising lesson plan that inspires her students to open their eyes to love and life.

programme.title: Long Gone Heroes
programme.desc: Gunner is a special forces soldier who returns to the field of battle to save his kidnapped niece in South America. He and his team soon discover that her disappearance is part of a corrupt private operation that hits way too close to home.

programme.title: Midnight in the Switchgrass
programme.desc: Two FBI agents cross paths with Crawford, a Florida cop who's investigating a string of murders that appear to be related. When an undercover sting goes horribly wrong, Crawford soon finds himself in a twisted game of cat and mouse with the killer.

programme.title: The Terminal
programme.desc: After arriving at New York's JFK airport, Viktor Navorski gets unwittingly caught in bureaucratic glitches that make it impossible for him to return to his home country or enter the U.S.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven (2016)
programme.desc: Director Antoine Fuqua brings his modern vision to the classic western, a story of seven outlaws who join together to save a town from an evil industrialist! Denzel Washington, Chris Pratt, Ethan Hawke and Vincent D'Onofrio and Peter Sarsgaard star!

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: Star Trek IX: Insurrection
programme.desc: When the crew of the Enterprise learns of the Federation's plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, Capt. Picard begins an open rebellion.

programme.title: Star Trek X: Nemesis
programme.desc: Set a course for a galaxy of unparalleled action and adventure as Captain Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his Starship crew battle a chilling new adversary…that happens to hold a shocking link to Picard!

programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: Gluttony, greed, sloth, envy, wrath, pride, lust—everyone has a sin. Detectives William Somerset and David Mills live among these sins every day. But nothing can prepare them for the killings they're about to experience.

programme.title: Man on Fire (2004)
programme.desc: A Marine swears vengeance on those who committed an act against the family he was hired to protect.

programme.title: Rocky Balboa
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born. But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool (2018)
programme.desc: Tiffany Haddish is hysterical in Tyler Perry's most outrageous comedy yet. Wild child Tanya looks to her buttoned-up sister Danica to get back on her feet. As these opposites collide, Tanya learns that Danica's perfect life may not be what it seems.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible II
programme.desc: The world's greatest spy, Ethan Hunt, returns and partners up with the beautiful Nyah Hall to stop renegade agent Sean Ambrose from releasing a new kind of terror on an unsuspecting world.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt hurdles into spectacular new adventures from Rome to Shanghai as he races to rescue a captured agent and stop Davian from eliminating his next target, Ethan’s wife.

programme.title: Red Rocket
programme.desc: Mikey Saber (a magnetic Simon Rex) — a charismatic con man and washed-up porn star — plots his return to the big time from small-town Texas in this wild, fiercely funny portrait of an American hustler and a hometown that barely tolerates him.

programme.title: Three Thousand Years of Longing
programme.desc: Dr. Alithea Binnie is an academic, a creature of reason. But while in Istanbul, she encounters a Djinn who offers her three wishes in exchange for his freedom. At first, she doubts him, but eventually she makes a wish... one that surprises them both!

programme.desc: What happens after you lose a six-figure job at one of the world's biggest tech companies?

programme.title: Big Batches: India (Pt I)
programme.desc: India: Process of cooking huge batches of food in different places around the world, explained by the chefs.

programme.title: Debunked: Brain Health & Vision
programme.desc: Brain Health & Vision: Consulting the experts to find the truth about the world's most common misconceptions.

programme.title: Pushing Limits: Dig & Lift
programme.desc: Digging Down & Lifting Weights: What's possible in technology, the human body, or the natural world.

programme.title: Big Business: Lifestyle
programme.desc: Lifestyle: An inside look at how companies solve logistical challenges at spectacular scale.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: A Dark Place
programme.desc: When a young boy goes missing in a sleepy backwoods town, a local sanitation truck driver, Donald, plays detective, embarking on a precarious and obsessive investigation.

programme.title: Spotlight [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 2001, editor Marty Baron of The Boston Globe assigns a team of journalists to investigate allegations against John Geoghan, an unfrocked priest accused of molesting more than 80 boys. Led by editor Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), reporters Michael Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo), Matt Carroll and Sacha Pfeiffer interview victims and try to unseal sensitive documents. The reporters make it their mission to provide proof of a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Freejack [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

programme.title: Assault On Precinct 13 [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: The lone inhabitants of an abandoned police station are under attack by the overwhelming numbers of a seemingly unstoppable street gang.

programme.title: American Yakuza
programme.desc: Viggo Mortensen ("Green Book") stars as an undercover FBI agent who has risen through the ranks of the Yakuza and now finds himself caught in a war between the Yakuza, the mob and the FBI.

programme.title: Un Noël à couper le souffle
programme.desc: Holly cache ses oeuvres au marché de Noël, se heurte à Jack et trouve l'amour là où elle s'y attendait le moins, grâce à ses pièces.

programme.title: Coup de foudre à l'hôtel de Noël
programme.desc: La vie de Georgia, la directrice d'un hôtel, est perturbée lorsqu'elle doit choisir entre Luke, un collègue, et Raymond, un prince.

programme.title: Dénouement de Noël
programme.desc: Mia, passionnée de romans d'amour, rencontre Beau, un philanthrope qui ressemble étrangement au héros de ses livres préférés.

programme.title: Dénouement de Noël
programme.desc: En livrant des cadeaux de Noël, Olivia se retrouve coincée par une tempête de neige… avec son ex!

programme.title: En route pour Noël
programme.desc: Neuf étrangers, bloqués dans un aéroport pendant le temps des fêtes, s'unissent pour se rendre à Denver par la route.

programme.title: Why Did I Get Married Too
programme.desc: Four couples struggle to save their marriages once again on their annual marriage retreat.

programme.title: Kate & Leopold
programme.desc: A Duke from 1876 is inadvertently dragged to modern day New York where he falls for an advertising exec.

programme.title: Moonrise Kingdom
programme.desc: A pair of young lovers flee their New England town, which causes a local search party to fan out to find them.

programme.title: Jersey Girl
programme.desc: A guy who thinks he's lost it all discovers he's got everything he needs.

programme.title: The Ambushers
programme.desc: Agent Matt Helm is sent to discover the location of an experimental flying saucer and keep from enemy hands.

programme.title: The Awful Truth
programme.desc: The screwball antics of a couple who can't stand being married, but don't want the other with anyone else.

programme.title: The Jolson Story
programme.desc: A young boy defies his father and his religion to become "America's greatest entertainer."

programme.title: Mr. Deeds Goes To Town
programme.desc: A millionare is declared insane when he announces that he'll give his fortune away to America's poor.

programme.title: Before the Devil Knows You're Dead
programme.desc: Andy (Philip Seymour Hoffman), a debt-ridden broker, needs some quick cash. He ropes his younger brother, Hank (Ethan Hawke), into a scheme to commit the perfect crime: to rob their parents' (Albert Finney, Rosemary Harris) jewelry store. The scheme goes horribly awry, and the family patriarch takes justice into his own hands, unaware that the criminals he is hunting are his own sons.

programme.title: Donnie Darko
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

programme.title: Pick It Up! Ska in the '90s
programme.desc: A documentary chronicling the rise and fall of Third Wave Ska music in the US of the 1990s.

programme.title: The Zombies: Hung Up On a Dream
programme.desc: The Zombies recall their musical path from teenage friends to legends in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

programme.title: Getting LOST
programme.desc: Getting Lost is a retrospective documentary celebrating the 20th anniversary of the cultural phenomenon Lost.

programme.title: Love, So Divine
programme.desc: Theology student Kyu-shik meets Bong-hee before ordination. They bond deeply and are attracted to each other.

programme.title: Begin to hear Korea
programme.desc: A film capturing a journey across Korea, collecting the diverse sounds of everyday life and bringing them together to create a single piece of music.

programme.title: K-CULTURE MINUTES: K-STORY Ep.22 Movie 《Teaching Practice: Idiot Girls and School Ghost 2》

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they've faced. After a multi-day journey by air and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester's Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska's wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it's bigger than ever. This time, we're in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida's most critical ecosystems. But it's not just about hard work—it's about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don't miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: As part of this year's Star brite Sea Safe event, we hit the water to experience some of the incredible fishing the Indian River Lagoon has to offer. For Rush, that meant some serious bow time with close friend Alex Hughey - on the hunt for some of the biggest snook we've ever encountered. The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. Don't miss this action-packed episode of the Sea Safe adventure from beautiful Sebastian, Florida!

programme.title: Mark Christopher Lawrence
programme.desc: Mark Christopher Lawrence (born May 22, 1964) is an American character actor, stand-up comedian, and voice-over artist. He is perhaps best known for his role as esoteric D.J., Tone Deaf, in the 1994 satirical rap mockumentary, Fear of a Black Hat. He has co-starred in popular films such as Terminator 2: Judgment Day, Planet of the Apes, Lost Treasure and The Pursuit of Happiness. Lawrence can currently be seen in his regular role as Big Mike on the NBC series Chuck. He has made guest appearances on many television programs, most notably Heroes, My Name Is Earl, Crossing Jordan, Dharma & Greg, Malcolm in the Middle, Touched by an Angel, Malcolm & Eddie, Men Behaving Badly, Seinfeld, Murphy Brown, and Martin. He is also featured on the Radio Series Adventures in Odyssey as "Ed Washington".

programme.title: The Monty Alexander Trio
programme.sub-title: Monty Alexander Quartet - Noth Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. On July 13, 1979, talented Jamaican pianist Monty Alexander was joined by Reggie Johnson (bass), Frank Gant (drums), Bobby Thomas (hand drum), and Othello Molineaux (steel drum) at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Alexander's Caribbean influences and natural flair for the piano shine through in this brilliant performance.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: A jazz festival named after the inventor of the instrument most associated with the genre, Adolphe Sax, would be incomplete without the man who laid the groundwork for how the instrument is played today. This must have been the reasoning of the organizers of the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, when they invited tenor saxophone giant Coleman Hawkins to perform there in June 1962. Appearing with a group that includes the French pianist George Arvanitas, one-time Duke Ellington bassist Jimmy Woode, and expat drummer Kansas Fields, the musician also known as ‘Bean' and ‘Hawk' serves up an hour-long set of familiar standards bookended by Hank Jones' “Chant” and J. J. Johnson's “Wee Dot”.

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: João Bosco
programme.desc: The vibrant island of Malta was in for a night of light and cheerful music when Brazilian music legend João Bosco took the stage on July 21, 2018. The self-taught guitarist made his music debut in the 1970s alongside Elis Regina and Aldir Blanc. In 2018, with guitarist Ricardo Silveira, bassist João Baptista and drummer Kiko Freitas, Bosco introduces us to his trademark melting pot of bossa nova, samba and MPB, sparingly influenced by contemporary jazz. Following his phenomenal successes in his native Brazil, the enthusiasm of the Maltese crowd underlines that João Bosco is now gradually achieving his long-overdue recognition elsewhere.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard, Al Grey, Alvin Batiste & Al Casey
programme.sub-title: Freddie Hubbard & The Satchmo Legacy Live in 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This concert of Freddie Hubbard and the Satchmo Legacy in 1987, highlights the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. Hubbard is an American jazz trumpeter whose unmistakable and influential tone contributed to new perspectives for modern jazz and bebop. He was also a well-known part of Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers and is primarily known for playing bebop, hard bop, and post-bop styles from the early '60s onwards.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. programme.title: McCoy Tyner, Avery Sharpe & Louis Hayes
programme.sub-title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner's first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson's and Art Farmer's Jazztet. He's also known for his work with the John Coltrane Quartet. Tyner's style is easily comparable to Coltrane's maximalist style of saxophone. Though a member of Coltrane's group, he was never overshadowed by the saxophonist, but complemented and even inspired Coltrane's open-minded approach. McCoy Tyner is considered one of the most influential jazz pianists of the 20th century, an honour he earned both with Coltrane and in his years of performing following Coltrane's death.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Keith Jarrett
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano. Known as the Standards Trio, they put on an enthralling performance that shows these master musicians at their best.

programme.title: Evgeny Kissin, Nikolai Demidenko, Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra & Antoni Wit
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: National Opera Oslo, Marita Sølberg, Diego Torre & Vasily Ladyuk
programme.desc: In 2012, Norwegian opera director Stefan Herheim brought Giacomo Puccini's opera La bohème to the stage of the Norwegian National Opera in Oslo. About his choice for this updated version, Herheim explained: “In bringing La bohème into a present-day setting with this new production we hope to revive the immediate power of suggestion and importance that this work at one time revelled in.” The opera about the Bohemian lifestyle of the poor seamstress Mimì and her artist friends is a fast-moving story, and offers some of the greatest arias Puccini ever wrote. Norwegian conductor Eivind Gullberg Jensen leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the National Opera Oslo. Among the soloists are Marita Sølberg (Mimì), Diego Torre (Rodolfo), Vasily Ladyuk (Marcello), and Jennifer Rowley (Musetta).

programme.title: Ragna Schirmer
programme.sub-title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828. Basing itself on her letters and diaries, her compositions, and on accounts from musicians who have intensively studied her music, this 2019 documentary offers a multi-angled perspective on Clara Schumann. It records the various places where she lived, and the cities she visited as a pianist. This thought-provoking film was directed by Andreas Morell and Magdalena Zieba-Schwind.

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra & Michael Tilson Thomas
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia'. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: Lukáš Vondráček, Michael Tilson Thomas & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Liszt's Concerto No. 1 & Mahler's Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: American ‘Conductor Laureate' Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a program of romantic masterworks. The concert opens with Franz Liszt's Piano Concerto No. 1, featuring the brilliant Czech pianist Lukáš Vondráček as soloist. The evening concludes with the emotional journey of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 5. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on May 15, 2022.

programme.title: Daryl Hall & John Oates
programme.sub-title: Hall & Oates - Live at Sydney Entertainment Centre
programme.desc: When Daryl Hall and John Oates took to the stage at Sydney's Entertainment Centre as the iconic bass line of ‘Maneater' began to play, the fans knew they were in for a treat. This duo may have been opening concerts with that irresistibly smooth number for years, but it never seems to lose its magic, and the crowd – an eclectic mix of teens and baby boomers alike – lapped it up. Daryl Hall and John Oates wisely reunited a few years ago after a string of solo projects, and although Oates no longer sports his signature ‘tache, they put on the kind of show that makes it hard to believe they even considered going their separate ways. Earworms like ‘I Can't Go For That', ‘Out Of Touch' and ‘Kiss On My List' were surefire reminders that these guys are absolute hit machines, and their catchy synth-soul classics probably deserve to permeate the airwaves as much today as they did decades ago. These Philly crooners still have it in bucket-loads, so this show should have everyone from diehard Daryl Hall and John Oates fans to kids of the 80's groovin' along in no time.

programme.title: The Clash
programme.sub-title: Rebel Truce: The history of The Clash
programme.desc: The Clash were one of the most influential bands to blow up from the Punk rock scene of 1977, with the late Joe Strummer revered as one the greatest front men in rock'n'Roll music history. 'Rebel Truce' have the visual style and excitement of the Clash with front man Jerry in particular delivering an outstanding live performance that has won over even the most sceptical Clash fans.

programme.title: Tom Odell
programme.desc: Having already conquered the UK with his chart-topping debut album ‘Long Way Down', don't miss Tom Odell's dazzling live show filmed at Irving Plaza, New York City. Watch the 22-year-old English wunderkind deliver stirring hits like ‘Another Love', as he brings his heart-wrenching album to life in gorgeous fashion.

programme.title: John Legend
programme.desc: An artist with intellectual skills is John Legend, who studied English with a major in African American literature at the University of Pennsylvania. In college, he participated in a jazz group called Counterparts and at the time was introduced to singer Lauryn Hill, playing piano on the track 'Everything Is Everything' from the singer's first solo album. He finished college in 1999 and began composing his own songs Recorded two independent albums that were sold in their performances: 'John Stephens' (2000) and 'Live at Jimmy Uptown' (2001). He has performed on albums of singers like Alicia Key, Jay-Z and also made the album Wake Up! (2010) along with the American rap group, The Roots. His official discography includes Get Lifted (2004), Once Again (2006), Evolver (2008) and Love in the Future (2013). This presentation in London, 2014, at the Itunes Festival, manages to clean the career of this singer who besides being multitalented can be a human rights activist.

programme.title: Seal
programme.desc: Seals one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. Hes delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career. And now, hes done it again with the release of his exceptional sixth studio album Soul. Together with legendary music producer David Foster, Seal adds his signature touch to some of the best soul songs ever created. In a stunning performance, Seal evokes an era when music vividly captured emotion and romance. Joined by Foster, as well as a choir and string section, Seal takes on Ann Pebbles I Cant Stand the Rain, Sam Cookes A Change Is Gonna Come, and Harold Melvin and the Blue Notes If You Dont Know Me By Now. Tune in and catch more timeless favorites and hits like Kiss From a Rose.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly, Carla Hall, and Michael Symon dive into an episode celebrating coffee and food pairing. The hosts prepare two standout recipes: a homemade Cinnamon Coffee Cake perfect for breakfast or dessert, and an authentic Buena Vista–Style Irish Coffee that brings San Francisco cafe tradition into home kitchens. Viewers get insider tips and techniques from three seasoned culinary professionals.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Michael Symon demonstrates how to make Korean-style short ribs using a quick grilling method combined with a flavorful Asian pear-based marinade featuring soy, mirin, gojuchang, and sesame oil. The thin-cut ribs marinate for 6-12 hours to tenderize, then grill for just 3 minutes per side over high heat. Michael garnishes the finished ribs with crispy scallions, cilantro, a sesame-chili mix, and lime. Meanwhile, Liz Symon prepares a refreshing soju mojito by muddling fresh mint and lime, then adding soju, lime juice, and maple syrup for depth. Liv Annacone joins the hosts as they discuss the ease and flavor of both dishes.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Michael Symon shares comprehensive garlic education on this Halloween-themed episode of Chewed Up, demonstrating proper peeling methods using a bowl-shaking technique, various cutting approaches including microplane mincing and hand-slicing, and the benefits of removing garlic germs to reduce bitterness. He advocates strongly for using whole fresh garlic rather than pre-peeled or jarred varieties, explaining how commercial processing compromises flavor. The episode culminates with preparation of luxurious Robuchon-style mashed potatoes—equal parts potatoes and butter—garnished with roasted garlic cloves, Parmigiano-Reggiano, fresh chives, and served alongside grilled garlic bread.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: On Simply Symons, Michael Symon prepares the famous Fat Doug burger, a signature dish from his former restaurant B Spot Burgers that won the Sobey Burger Bash championship twice. The burger features crispy pastrami, melted Swiss cheese, and tangy coleslaw on a potato roll. Meanwhile, co-host Liz Symon creates an improvisational cherry cola cocktail made with Averna Amaro, Cointreau, amaretto cherries, and seltzer that unexpectedly tastes remarkably like classic Coke. The episode explores the burger's history, cooking technique over live fire, and the importance of quality ingredients and balanced flavors.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: The hosts welcome Jules Esposito, director of food and beverage operations for the Charlie Palmer Collective and Appalachian Hotels, to celebrate summer entertaining. Jules shares her Stone Fruit Panzanella recipe—a bread salad featuring stone fruits, tomatoes, fresh herbs, and a white balsamic vinaigrette that's ideal for casual gatherings. The episode explores Jules's journey from event planning in Paris to her current role overseeing operations for Charlie Palmer's restaurant empire, plus spirited discussions about seasonal eating, herb gardens, pizza regionalism, and the art of hosting.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Michael Symon and Clinton Kelly kick off July 4th week with guest Jeanette Donnarumma, a returning favorite from the Rachael Ray Show who pioneered the "Watermelon Palooza" segment. Together they prepare summer cookout essentials: Watermelon Aperol Margaritas with frozen fruit ice, a Watermelon Cucumber Salad served in an artfully carved watermelon bowl, and taste-test limited-edition Lay's World Cup chips. The episode celebrates simple, accessible recipes perfect for backyard gatherings, with Donnarumma sharing pro tips on watermelon carving and ingredient selection while the hosts discuss recipe inspiration and kitchen mood-boosters.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Michael Symon joins Clinton Kelly and Stacy London for a July Fourth-themed episode where he teaches the notoriously non-cooking Stacy how to grill skirt steak with a quick charred corn salsa featuring tomatillos, jalapeños, and garlic. The episode showcases fundamental cooking techniques including seasoning, temperature control, and proper resting. Stacy surprises the group with an air fryer and attempts to make dairy-free s'mores using gluten-free cookies and specialty peanut butter cups, leading to comedic mishaps. The hosts also discuss their new show "Why'd They Wear That," where they critique character wardrobes from films and television. The episode emphasizes that cooking is about patience, proper technique, and feeding people you care about.
